notes.title: hoptix: Tower of Targets, a free update, out today!
notes.content: [p]After hoptix launched, we realized there was just one more thing that felt like it needed to be in the game... and got right to work! We're expanding our second least controversial feature (right after a certain gravity-changing camera-spinning gimmick), target breaking tests! There's lots to explore in the main path, but what target-terrorizing game is complete without a side-mode full of more traditional, small-scale bonus trials? [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459218/14f52014460ee86c15a4957487b49a5d3f136d81.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]hoptix: Tower of Targets features 10 brand new EX-stages, featuring a variety of different level design approaches that wouldn't have fit the core game: some are more difficult, some are more linear, and some are just a little wackier. These are also playable in Free Ride mode, for those who'd prefer to just get their paws on a handful of new sandboxes! [/p][p][/p][p]To unlock the new stages, you'll need to find and complete Moondust Conservatory Track 2, so keep an eye out in Track 1 if you haven't nabbed the unlock CD! [/p][p][/p][p]Also: as a reward for completing each of the new stages in Classic or Time Trial mode, you'll unlock 4 new dye styles inspired by certain late game areas! [/p][p][/p][p]And speaking of spinning camera gimmicks: we've added a new "Reduced Camera Motion" setting in the options menu to attempt to address the problems some of our players have had with a certain later game level. While disabling the camera effect entirely would have rendered the level very difficult to play, we're hoping the new visual transition is a little easier on the eyes for those who are sensitive to this type of motion.[/p][p][/p][p]Rounding out the changes, hoptix: Tower of Targets comes with a handful of fixes for rare physics edge-cases (as well as a few pesky UI or sprite layering bugs...), so the game should feel more solid than ever! [/p][p][/p][p]As always, thanks for playing hoptix![/p]

notes.title: It's bandcamp Friday! + What are we up to?
notes.content: [p]Happy Friday rad rabbits! Today's the first bandcamp Friday since the full release of hoptix! For those who don't know, bandcamp Friday is a day where bandcamp takes a generous 0% cut of all music sales, and every dollar goes to support your favorite artists (give or take payment processing fees...)[/p][p][/p][p]Which means if you enjoyed the soundtrack to hoptix, today's a great day to pick it up over on [url="https://catburglargames.bandcamp.com/album/hoptix-original-soundtrack"]our bandcamp page[/url]! All proceeds go directly to our wonderful team musician, so it's a great way to show some appreciation. The soundtrack is available [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3775650/hoptix_Soundtrack/"]here[/url] as well, for those of you who prefer building your music library here on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459218/13ff489a398b812e12deff195f698661de5461f8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]What else is up?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We mentioned earlier that we couldn't help but get to work on one last thing for hoptix, post release. I won't spoil the surprise just yet, but it's a little something extra that we felt the best possible, most deluxe version of this game should include... And it's about 85% done! As always, we're a tiny team, and anything can happen, but hoptix 1.1 should be ready for launch within the next month, so get excited for our little post launch bonus adventure! [/p][p][/p][p]Finally, some cool moves from the team:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459218/4f65133e0d05a57895c2acb07d1e2d312f5e269f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As always, thanks for playing hoptix! [/p]

notes.title: hoptix 1.0 has fully released out of Early Access!
notes.content:
The day is finally here everybunny! Welcome to hoptix 1.0! If you've been waiting for the full, polished, complete experience to hop in, now's your time! hoptix is now feature complete, with every originally intended level, a finished soundtrack, and several rounds of physics optimizations. 2025's most rabbit acrobatic game, guaranteed, is now fully available. If you find yourself jamming to the soundtrack, you can find that on Bandcamp [url=https://catburglargames.bandcamp.com/album/hoptix-original-soundtrack]here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459218/13ff489a398b812e12deff195f698661de5461f8.png[/img]

For our wonderful Early Access players, here's a rundown of the big new changes: 

[list]
[*] The eighth and final area of the game, and the thrilling conclusion to Rocket's big day. 
[*] Turbocharged and mastered soundtrack, and a fancy new music transition system.  
[*] A new type of collectible to find, and a suite of Steam achievements to hunt. 
[*] A visual overhaul of some of the earliest-design levels for better visual clarity, better match to the rest of the game's art style, and also they just look better now.
[*] A Target Break overhaul featuring a much more exciting target breaking animation and feel, targets placed in more exciting locations, and new moving targets. 
[*] Improved physics at low speeds.
[*] ...and more!
[/list]

We kind of can't believe we're really here. 

With love, excitement, and disbelief, 
Cat Burglar Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459218/e86f092a6131a27c90d16e5e1cf31fb3324b033f.png[/img]

notes.title: hoptix will exit Early Access on May 28th!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We realize it's been a little longer than usual since our last update. Between you and me, we might have indulged in just a little bit of scope creep with some last minute features and additions before launch... but we're prouder than ever of the game we've made and we can't wait to get it out the door! 

Luckily, we won't have to wait long, because we've decided to release the hoptix 1.0 on [b]May 28th![/b] Get excited for the thrilling conclusion to Rocket's journey, a brand new area, new collectibles, improved physics and music, and more! Whether you've been playing along in Early Access, or waiting until full release to hop in, we're excited to see you tear it up next week.

notes.title: Development Hop-Along #4
notes.content:
Hello and happy February everybunny! We can't believe how much time has already passed since the Halloween Is Tomorrow update. After we launched the new area, we went right back to work on the last section of the game. Our momentum is unstoppable! 

I'm excited to say that Track 1 for the final area has already been fully designed, and is about halfway through the visual process. It's surreal to think that we'll be working on the very last level in the game soon, after almost three years in development! 

Visually, this last area's got more raw spectacle than any other part of the game, and I think it's going to really knock some socks off... 

[b]So what's left to do?[/b]

Well, besides the last half of the visual stuff for Track 1, and designing and drawing Track 2 of our secret final area, we've also got a number of polish things we'd like to accomplish before our big 1.0 launch. This includes stuff like visual passes on older environments, looking at some minor rough edges in camera logic, and other fun features like Steam achievements. 

All told, we're still looking at at least two months of work, but we're getting really close to the finish line! We hope you'll keep cheering us on through the final stretch! 

Lastly, here are some cool, winter-ific moves from the team:

As always, thank you for playing hoptix!

notes.title: 🎃🎃The Halloween Is Tomorrow Update!!🎃🎃
notes.content:
Welcome to hoptix 0.9.5! This major update marks the halfway point between Early Access launch and 1.0! The 🎃 Halloween Is Tomorrow 🎃 update features: 

[b]- Dark Autumn, a full new area with a second Track to find and unlock! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459218/049ac33eda0101a916d0aa80188785e166b11d9e.gif[/img]

Please note, you may need to replay either Track from Ion Oasis to unlock the new area, but you're going to want to anyway, because...

[b]- Updated music for Ion Oasis! [/b]

Ion Oasis' theme music has been extended to include multiple new crackling, ozone-scented sections to shred to! And lastly, a small feature many of you have asked for... 

[b]- Target Assist, an onscreen indicator to point you towards the last target in a section! [/b]

We want to strike the right balance between encouraging players to explore, and keeping them from feeling frustrated. Based on feedback, it seems like the right balance might involve helping people find that last, dastardly target...

If you find this new feature invasive or distracting, there's a new option in the Options menu which disables it. 

As always, thank you for playing hoptix! We'd love to hear what you think about the update in the Steam forums, or through the official game email, hoptixgame@gmail.com !

notes.title: Development Hop-Along #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! While we're in Early Access, we'd like to do a monthly check-in to let you all know how things are going! 

[b]How'd Early Access launch go?[/b]

Really awesome! Right now we're sitting at 100% positive reviews here on Steam, which we're really grateful for. It's been amazing seeing people finally playing our game and showcasing their unique approach to it. This is a really exciting foundation for our big 1.0 launch to build off of!

[b]What have we been working on for the last month?[/b]

Initially, we spent some time working on polish based on feedback from the first wave of players. Some spots needed to be walled off a bit, and some seams needed to be tightened up so Rocket couldn't fit through them and get into the wall anymore. Oops! 

Since then, I've been working really hard on the background art for the next area in the game. This one's really important, so I've been letting myself go a little wild; there's about 3x the sheer amount of art as most of the other backgrounds. I think this is really gonna knock some socks off! 

Soon we'll be able to get into the meat of level design for the next area. We're a small team, so minor setbacks can change the timeline really drastically, but it's looking like we'll be able to share the first of our final two areas with you around [b]January[/b] or so. I hope you're half as excited as I am!!  

Finally, here are a few gifs from the team:

notes.title: hoptix hotfix #3
notes.content:
Happy Friday rad rabbits! We've just got a handful of very minor bug fixes for you today. 

- Tightened up some seams in a few spots in Bright Autumn and Sunset Static that Rocket was able to clip through under precise conditions. We swear, rabbits are made of liquid...
- Rocket has brushed up on their basic physics and will now make extra sure to properly dispose of their inertia after jumping off of a moving platform.

Thanks for playing hoptix!

notes.title: hoptix hotfix #2
notes.content:
Back at it again with another hotfix!

- As part of a minor physics change in hotfix #1, Rocket was a little overeager to jump ahead to new surfaces while walking at low speeds. They've learned to be a bit more patient. 
- A certain early game rooftop has been somewhat rabbit-proofed. We're not here to tell you what to do, but we think that particular skip was a little too easy... 
- Some landings have been softened to be not so bad, even if Rocket misses landing on the downhill slope. 
- Our gif camera operator will get less dizzy in Bright Autumn. 
- Changed behavior of a UI element during certain sequence breaks. :)

Thanks for playing hoptix!

notes.title: hoptix hotfix #1
notes.content:
Happy Friday rad rabbits! Our first hotfix is live, tackling some recurring bugs that are hopefully gone for good. 

- Rocket should always remember to stay in time trial mode when restarting a time trial level now.
- Rocket should have a much more difficult time clipping into walls, where they're not supposed to be. 

Thanks for playing hoptix!

notes.content:

We can't wait to see what you'll all do!
